assertions.name: the dissipation-scale crossing B* exists for every eps in the sweep (theta_n < 1 for all rungs beyond it), once the ladder is long enough to reach the physical dissipation scale
assertions.source: theta_n = sup_t u_n/(nu*k_n) profile per rung, layer-invariant; ladder length eps-scaled to k_phys ~ 2

assertions.name: the crossing's physical wavenumber is bounded above by the Kolmogorov prediction k_phys* = 2^{3/4} eps^{1/4} and is monotone DECREASING in the sweep — the crossing moves down as eps -> 0, so the dissipation-scale condition gets EASIER toward the classical limit (bounded-above is the sharp statement; the measured decay ~eps^0.6 is faster than the eps^{1/4} prediction, i.e. the finite ladder dissipates harder than continuum Kolmogorov)
assertions.source: theta ~ (sup u)/(nu_phys k_phys) with Kolmogorov sup u ~ k_sub^{-1/3} gives theta = 2 eps^{1/3} k_phys^{-4/3}, crossing at 2^{3/4} eps^{1/4}; measured k_phys(B*) = 0.9487 / 0.2202 / 0.1039 at eps = 1e-1 / 1e-2 / 3e-3

assertions.name: the per-rung trajectory equilibrium ratio r_n = sup u_n / ((sup u_{n-1})^2/(nu*k_n)) is <= 1 on every empty-start rung at every eps — rung_equilibrium's bound holds along actual trajectories (remainder (a), empirical face)
assertions.source: max over rungs n >= N_DATA of r_n, per eps

description: SF7 (bean qou-qzh2): probe-level check of the amplitude repair's one in-model hypothesis (PR #5066) — the band-at-dissipation-scale condition theta_n = sup u_n/(nu*k_n) < 1 beyond a crossing rung B*, plus the eps-uniformity of the crossing's physical wavenumber k_phys(B*) = q^{B*}-1, plus the per-rung trajectory equilibrium ratio r_n <= 1 (rung_equilibrium along actual DN runs). Same integrator and data as SF6 (N=32, unforced, band-limited first-4-rung data, T=10 eddy, ladder length eps-scaled to reach k_phys ~ 2). theta is layer-invariant (nu*k converts by (q-1)*c_q = 1); the layer question is where the crossing sits in physical wavenumber. Scope (a); float64 RK2 exploratory tier; full-NS nonlocality caveat untouched.
